description: AML Screen with Behavioural Profiling — deep AML assessment combining sanctions matching (OFAC, EU, UN, OFSI), behavioural pattern analysis, transaction velocity signals, and counterparty network risk. Returns CLEAR / REVIEW / BLOCK decision with confidence score, matched sanctions lists, behavioural anomaly flags, and a structured compliance narrative for audit. Use for high-value payments, onboarding, or any counterparty flagged by flow_check. Accepts wallet address or entity identifier. x402 paid, USDC on Base.

amountUsd.description: Transaction amount — used for velocity profiling. Optional.

entity.description: Wallet address, LEI, or name of the counterparty to screen.

purpose.description: Payment purpose — used for behavioural context. Optional.

name: compliance.aml_screen

behavioural.description: Velocity flags, counterparty network risk, anomaly signals.

narrative.description: Structured compliance narrative for audit record.

sanctionHits.description: Matched sanctions list entries with list name and match score.
